ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Needs_Invoice__c, OR(ISBLANK(Legal_Name__c), NOT(REGEX(UPPER(RFC__c), "[A-Z&]{3,4}[0-9]{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}")), ISBLANK(Postal_Code__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Tax_Regime__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(CFDI_Use__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice requests require a legal name, valid RFC, postal code, tax regime, and CFDI use.
